```{r}

library(tidyverse) 
library(primer.data)
```

```{r}
set.seed(10)

x <- nhanes |>
  filter(age >= 18 & age <= 27) |>
  select(height, sex) |>
  drop_na() |>
  slice_sample(n = 50) 
```

A persons heights is dependent on many factors related to their genetics and health. By examining data on USMC recruits from 2009-2011 from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, we will attempt to answer the question "What is the average height of male and female USMC recruits?"
